stories.story_fr: L'ARR AI-first triple en glissement annuel et depasse 500 millions de dollars au T2 FY2026, signe que la monetisation IA d'Adobe passe a l'echelle.
stories.story_en: AI-first ARR triples year over year and surpasses $500 million in Q2 FY2026, showing Adobe's AI monetization is reaching scale.
stories.quote: AI-first ARR triples year over year and exceeds $500 million

stories.story_fr: L'ARR total d'Adobe atteint 27,10 milliards de dollars en sortie de T2 FY2026, dont environ 480 millions provenant de l'acquisition de Semrush.
stories.story_en: Total Adobe ARR reaches $27.10 billion exiting Q2 FY2026, including roughly $480 million from the Semrush acquisition.
stories.quote: Total Adobe Annualized Recurring Revenue ("ARR") exiting the quarter was $27.10 billion, including approximately $480 million from Semrush.

stories.story_fr: Le revenu d'abonnement Business Professionals & Consumers progresse de 16% sur un an au T2 FY2026, le segment le plus dynamique d'Adobe.
stories.story_en: Business Professionals & Consumers subscription revenue grows 16% year over year in Q2 FY2026, Adobe's fastest-growing segment.
stories.quote: Business Professionals & Consumers subscription revenue was $1.85 billion, which represents 16% year-over-year growth, or 15% in constant currency.

stories.story_fr: Des le T1 FY2026, l'ARR AI-first fait plus que tripler en glissement annuel, confirmant la traction des nouveaux produits IA aupres des clients.
stories.story_en: As early as Q1 FY2026, AI-first ARR more than triples year over year, confirming customer traction for Adobe's new AI products.
stories.quote: AI-first ARR more than triples year over year

stories.story_fr: Adobe rachete environ 8,5 millions d'actions au T2 FY2026, poursuivant un retour de capital agressif aux actionnaires.
stories.story_en: Adobe repurchases about 8.5 million shares in Q2 FY2026, continuing aggressive capital returns to shareholders.
stories.quote: Adobe repurchased approximately 8.5 million shares during the quarter.
